section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a single study (Study X). Data were collected online via Prolific Academic from 315 participants (151 women, 164 men) in the US, with a mean age of 32.55 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 25.85. The sample was predominantly White (88.9%), and 63.1% had an undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
